source_title: MY DR NOW Brings Seven-Day Family Medicine to Sunnyvale, Challenging the Traditional Doctor's Office Model
source_excerpt:
SUNNYVALE, Texas , Oct. 30, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- MY DR NOW will open its newest family medicine clinic in Sunnyvale at 8 a.m. Monday, Nov. 2, and it will be open every day of the week: 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. Monday through Friday and 8 a.m. to 4 p.m. Saturday and Sunday. Families can walk in or book a same-day visit for family medicine, pediatrics and women's health, from checkups to ongoing care.
The clinic is at 200 E. Town East Blvd., Suite 104, on the southeast corner of Belt Line Road and Town East Boulevard, in the new Sunnyvale Commons at Gateway Park anchored by Tom Thumb. With US-80, I-635 and I-30 close by, it serves families in Sunnyvale and neighboring towns.
Texas ranks last in the nation in primary care providers per capita, according to America's Health Rankings. Locally, the family medicine practices MY DR NOW reviewed in Sunnyvale, Mesquite and Rowlett mostly keep weekday-only schedules, and none is open seven days a week. MY DR NOW's Sunnyvale clinic will be.
"Healthcare shouldn't dictate when you can see a doctor. Your life should," said Dr. Payam Zamani, founder and CEO of MY DR NOW. "Traditional primary care has operated around the convenience of the healthcare system for far too long. We're changing that by making care available when and where people actually need it, seven days a week."
Patients see the same practice and the same medical records whether they come in on a Sunday afternoon or a Tuesday morning, so every visit connects to their annual checkups, vaccinations and long-term care for conditions such as diabetes and high blood pressure.
The clinic provides family medicine, pediatrics and women's health, along with preventive care and annual checkups, chronic disease management, sports and school physicals, immunizations and virtual visits.
Founded in 2007 by Payam Zamani, MD, and headquartered in Phoenix, MY DR NOW has reimagined primary care around accessibility, convenience and continuity. Through a consumer-focused healthcare model that combines neighborhood clinics, walk-in care, same-day appointments, virtual visits, house calls, extended hours and coordinated follow-up care, the organization helps patients access healthcare on their schedule. With more than 80 clinics across Arizona and Texas and more than 1,000 team members, MY DR NOW is expanding its mission to make healthcare easier to access, navigate and afford. The company provides family medicine, pediatrics, women's health, preventive care and chronic disease management throughout the communities it serves.
For more information or to schedule an appointment, visit www.MYDRNOW.com or call 480-677-8282.
